senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָיָה)living, alive; living creature; healthy.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 27b:18">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלא אני חי והוא מת יכול החי וכ׳</he> if I were alive and he dead, the living one might give the lie to the dead.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:5">Ib. V, 5</cite> <he>זה חי</he> this one is destined to live (recover).

<cite ref="Shabbat 94a:2">Sabb. 94ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>החי נושא את עצמו</he> a living being carries itself (the carrying of a living being on the Sabbath is not unlawful). Ib. X, 5 <he>את החי במטה</he> (he who carries) a living person on a couch; a. v. fr.—<he>אבר מן החי</he>, v. <cite ref="A00202"><he>אֵבֶר</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="H00736"><he>חַיִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00737"><he>חַיִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite> <he>והח׳ לידון</he> and the living are destined to be judged.
<cite ref="Shabbat 94a:2">Sabb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>בין ח׳ ובין שחוטין</he> whether alive or slaughtered; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 5b:10">Ab. Zar. 5ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>החי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:19">Gen. VI, 19</cite>) <he>שחיין ראשי וכ׳</he> the ends of whose limbs live (exist).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 70a:7">Snh. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>בשר חי</he> raw meat, <he>יין חי</he> unmixed wine.
Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ, a. fr. הנאכל כמות שהוא חי what is eatable in its natural state; a. fr.—Fem. חַיָּה.

<cite ref="Chullin 42a">Ḥull. 42ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 11:2">Lev. XI, 2</cite>) <he>ח׳ אכול וכ׳</he> what is in a healthy condition (viable), you may eat, v. <cite ref="I00811"><he>טְרֵפָה</he></cite>. [V. <cite ref="H00672"><he>חַיָּה</he></cite>.]
